lines.en: label beachwars16:
scene clearnightsky
{i}There’s a certain something in the air tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}今晚的空气里,有某种特别的东西。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I speak not of fire or ash, nor the rising embers the eyes of laughing children gravitate to as they drift closer to the sky — but of sorrow and safety. Delight and dismay.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我说的不是火,也不是灰,更不是那些欢笑的孩子望着飘向天空的飞升余烬——而是悲伤与安全。喜悦与沮丧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And I speak this all to you, of course. For you are the only one fit to recount this journey of yours or mine or whoever it belongs to.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}而这一切,我当然都是对你说的。因为只有你才配讲述这段旅途——无论它是你的、我的,还是属于别的什么人的。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I did something bad tonight.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}今晚我做了一件坏事。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I’ve been doing that a lot lately — getting pickier with the rules I follow and the ones I overlook...but I promise it’s all for a good reason!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}最近我经常这样——对该遵守哪些规则、该忽略哪些规则越来越挑剔……但我保证,这一切都是有正当理由的!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You see, one day, I want to make the world a better place.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你看,总有一天,我想让这个世界变得更好。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But one of the big issues with that is that “better” for one person has the potential to mean “worse” for another. And that’s the exact sort of thing I’d like to avoid if at all possible.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但其中的一个大问题是,对某个人来说的「更好」,有可能意味着对另一个人来说的「更糟」。而这正是我想尽一切可能避免的事。{/i}

lines.en: {i}So, as inevitable or unlikely as it may be, I will trek through this sand for as long as I have to. Hoping that whatever my metal-detector of a mind can pick up along the coast is enough to make you happy.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}所以,无论它注定发生还是希望渺茫,我都会在这片沙滩上跋涉下去,需要走多久就走多久。只希望我这台像金属探测器一样的大脑沿海岸拾到的东西,足以让你开心。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But a little birdie tells me it won’t be before another shows up and swallows it whole.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但有只小鸟告诉我,用不了多久就会有另一个出现,把它整个吞下去。{/i}

lines.en: {i}These creatures will grow until they’re far larger than me.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}这些生物会一直长大,直到远比我庞大。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But that’s not saying a lot as, right now, I don’t exist.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过这话说服力不大,因为此时此刻,我并不存在。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I am but a thought in your head or a passing desire.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我不过是你脑海中的一个念头,或是一闪而过的欲望。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I am the light of the moon and the shadow that follows closely behind you.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我是月亮的光,也是紧紧跟在你身后的影子。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I am everything you’ve never wanted, but all you’ll ever need.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我是一切你从未想要的东西,却也是你永远需要的一切。{/i}

lines.en: {i}And sure as the sunshine, our lives are in bloom.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}就像阳光必然降临一样,我们的生命正在绽放。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I will follow you always.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我会永远追随你。{/i}

lines.en: {i}I simply can’t help it.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我只是情不自禁。{/i}

lines.en: All of a sudden, I see heads tilting upward.
lines.zh: 突然间,我看到一张张脸仰了起来。

lines.en: And a new light emerges from the darkest of nights.
lines.zh: 而一道新的光,从最深沉的夜色中浮现。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere1
: Attention, everyone!
lines.zh: : 大家注意!

lines.en: : Your beloved and {i}beautiful{/i} blonde bombshell, Ayane Amamiya, has returned from her fateful venture into the woods to remind you all that it is {i}she{/i} who holds a claim on the teacher’s heart! No one else!
lines.zh: : 你们可爱又{i}美丽{/i}的金发尤物 Ayane Amamiya,已经从那场命运般的森林冒险中归来了!她要提醒你们所有人——拥有老师那颗心的人是{i}我{/i}!不是别人!

lines.en: : Ayane!
lines.zh: : Ayane!

lines.en: : A...Ayane! You’re back!
lines.zh: : A……Ayane!你回来了!

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere2
: What the fuck happened to you?! You’ve been gone for almost twenty-four hours!
lines.zh: : 你他妈到底出了什么事?!你都失踪快二十四小时了!

lines.en: : I was just taking a much-needed vacation, Maya. But now I’m back and better than ever.
lines.zh: : 我只是去度了个我迫切需要的假,Maya。不过现在我回来了,而且比以往任何时候都好。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere3
: And also really hungry. Have you guys eaten dinner yet?
lines.zh: : 而且我还很饿。你们吃过晚饭了吗?

lines.en: : Have we...{i}eaten?...{/i}
: Do you...do you have any idea how much everyone’s been worried about you?
lines.zh: : 你……你知不知道大家有多担心你?

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere4
: Not that much by the look of things. But I guess that’s what I deserve for opening up my glorious return with a stake on Sensei’s heart.
lines.zh: : 看样子也没那么担心。不过我想,用「宣布对 Sensei 的心拥有主权」来开场我的荣耀回归,也算是自作自受吧。

lines.en: : Ayane...are you seriously okay? You seem way too...{i}chipper{/i} for someone who was just lost in the woods for a shocking amount of time.
lines.zh: : Ayane……你真的没事吗?对于一个刚刚在森林里迷路、迷了久到吓人的时间的人来说,你看起来……也太{i}精神焕发{/i}了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m totally fine. Just needed a little reset.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我完全没事。只是需要稍微重置一下。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere5
: That’s really great, Ayane! I’ve been so worried about you ever since last night.
lines.zh: : 真是太好了,Ayane!从昨晚开始我就一直好担心你。

lines.en: : You were...literally fine this morning.
lines.zh: : 你今天早上……明明还好好的啊。

lines.en: scene black
: I was obviously just pretending to be fine! As if I could even think straight with my best friend lost in the woods!
lines.zh: : 我那显然是装出来的!最好的朋友在森林里走丢了,我怎么可能还正常思考!

lines.en: : Sensei, come on! Let’s go welcome Ayane back to the beach!
lines.zh: : Sensei,快来!我们去欢迎 Ayane 回到海滩!

lines.en: My adorable and loving niece, Ami Arakawa, grabs my hand and pulls me closer to Ayane — who is, very thankfully, still alive.
lines.zh: 我那可爱又黏人的侄女 Ami Arakawa 抓住我的手,把我拉到 Ayane 身边——而 Ayane 万幸还活着。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere6
: Are you really okay? You’re not hurt at all? Not even a little?
lines.zh: : 你真的没事吗?一点伤都没有?一点点都没有?

lines.en: : Not even a little. In fact, I’d like to {i}thank{/i} you for taking me way further out than you were probably supposed to, Ami. It really worked out in my favor, weirdly enough.
lines.zh: : 一点点都没有。事实上,我还得{i}谢谢{/i}你把我带到了比你应该带到的地方远得多的地方,Ami。说来也怪,结果反倒帮了我大忙。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere7
: Further than-
lines.zh: : 比应该到的更——

lines.en: : I did no such thing! I followed the directions exactly as they were written! But I never would have followed them at all if I’d have known you’d be lost for so long!
lines.zh: : 我根本没有!我完全是按指示上写的做的!可要是我早知道你会迷路那么久,我根本就不会照着做!

lines.en: : {i}Regardless{/i} of what your intentions were, I have returned.
lines.zh: : {i}不管{/i}你的意图是什么,总之我回来了。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere8
: And I’d very much like to have a nice, long talk with you before tomorrow morning, Ami. As best friends, of course. Which we definitely are.
lines.zh: : 而且我非常想明天早上之前和你好好长谈一次,Ami。当然是以好朋友的身份。而我们也绝对是好朋友。

lines.en: : O-Of course! I’d love that!
lines.zh: : 当——当然!我很乐意!

lines.en: : Are you going to say anything? Or are you just going to stand there like an emotionless blob? Ayane was gone for almost an entire day. The least you can do is welcome her back.
lines.zh: : 你打算说点什么吗?还是打算像一坨没有感情的烂泥一样站在那儿?Ayane 失踪了将近一整天。你至少也该欢迎她回来吧。

lines.en: : Welcome back, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来,Ayane。

lines.en: : You had me worried for a little while, but I think I knew you were always going to wind up back here.
lines.zh: : 你让我担心了一阵子,不过我想,我心里一直知道你总会回到这里的。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere9
: And thank {i}you,{/i} Sensei. For providing half of the motivation I needed to make it out of the woods. I love you very much.
lines.zh: : 还有谢谢{i}你{/i},Sensei。是你给了我走出森林所需的一半动力。我非常爱你。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere10
: Did you hear that, class?! I said I love the teacher! And I’m going to marry him some day! You better believe it!
lines.zh: : 大家都听到了吗?!我说了我爱老师!而且我总有一天要嫁给他!你们最好给我相信!

lines.en: : Half?...
scene black
scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere11
: It’s great Ayane finally made it back. Now, we’ll be able to avoid pretty much any lawsuit thrown our way at the end of the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : Ayane 总算回来了,太好了。这样一来,宿舍战争结束时我们基本就能躲掉任何甩过来的官司了。

lines.en: : Unless Miss Watabe decides to throw us under the bus for indecent exposure or whatever. But even then, Sensei will probably have to take the heat for all of it because he’s-
lines.zh: : 除非 Watabe 老师为了猥亵暴露什么的把我们出卖了。不过就算那样,Sensei 大概也得替所有人背锅,因为他是——

lines.en: : A totally normal guy with totally normal taste in girls?
lines.zh: : 一个完全正常、对女生的品味也完全正常的家伙?

lines.en: : Exactly. There’s nothing suspicious about him at all. I like the way you think, Uta.
lines.zh: : 没错。他身上一点可疑的地方都没有。我喜欢你的思路,Uta。

lines.en: : If thinking this way prevents my mind from going places it’s not supposed to, I can force myself to believe whatever it takes!
lines.zh: : 如果这样想能阻止我的脑子跑到不该去的地方,那我什么都可以逼自己去相信!

lines.en: : Oh? Can you?
lines.zh: : 哦?是吗?

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere12
: Actually, no. That was a lie. I don’t really know why I said that. I’m probably just trying to convince myself or something.
lines.zh: : 其实,不行。那是谎话。我也不知道自己为什么那么说。大概只是想说服我自己之类的。

lines.en: : In fact, if anything, my specialty is probably thinking exactly what I’m {i}not{/i} supposed to think. Like, basically all the time.
lines.zh: : 事实上,要说专长的话,我大概恰恰擅长去想那些{i}不该{/i}想的东西。基本上,无时无刻。

lines.en: : Wanna tell me what you’re thinking right now?
lines.zh: : 想告诉我你现在在想什么吗?

lines.en: : I’m thinking that I should tell you what I’m thinking. Which is probably the exact {i}opposite{/i} thing I should be thinking about.
lines.zh: : 我在想,我应该告诉你在我在想什么。而这大概正是我最{i}不该{/i}去想的事。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere13
: How do you manage to stay so energetic all the time despite having such a complicated thought process?
lines.zh: : 你的思维这么复杂,到底是怎么做到一直这么精力充沛的?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Yoga, maybe?
lines.zh: : 不知道。也许是瑜伽?

lines.en: : You do yoga?
lines.zh: : 你做瑜伽?

lines.en: : No. I have no idea why I keep lying tonight.
lines.zh: : 不做。我也不知道自己今晚为什么一直撒谎。

lines.en: : Do I make you nervous or something?
lines.zh: : 是我让你紧张了还是怎么的?

lines.en: : Yes.
: Is that a lie too?
lines.zh: : 这也是谎话?

lines.en: : Yes.
: I have no idea what I’m supposed to believe anymore.
lines.zh: : 我已经完全不知道该相信什么了。

lines.en: : Just stop paying attention to me altogether. We’ve only got one contest left and poor Futaba’s probably just waiting for us to stop talking to get things started.
lines.zh: : 干脆别再管我了。我们只剩最后一场比赛了,可怜的 Futaba 大概就等着我们别再说话好开始呢。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere14
: Thank you, Uta. Please don’t...expect too much out of me, though. I don’t typically write horror and...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你,Uta。不过请别……对我期望太高。我平时不怎么写恐怖故事,而且……

lines.en: : And actually, even if I did, there probably wouldn’t be much to expect. I’m not very good. I just...like the act of writing.
lines.zh: : 其实,就算我写过,大概也没什么好期待的。我写得并不好。我只是……喜欢写这个动作本身。

lines.en: : I’m sure that whatever you’ve come up with will be quite delightful, Futaba. Though, I am a bit of a connoisseur, so I {i}will{/i} be judging you harshly. But I assure you I mean no offense.
lines.zh: : 我相信你写出来的东西一定相当有趣,Futaba。不过我算是个行家,所以我{i}会{/i}从严评判。但我向你保证,我并无恶意。

lines.en: : That...makes me a lot more confident. Thank you, Touka.
lines.zh: : 这……让我自信多了。谢谢你,Touka。

lines.en: : No, Futaba. Thank {i}you{/i}. For engaging in a competition that does not revolve around pleasing our teacher, but good, old fashioned fun. We need more of that around here.
lines.zh: : 不,Futaba。该说谢谢的是我。谢谢{i}你{/i}参加一场不为讨好老师、只为了纯粹的老式乐趣而进行的比赛。我们这儿正需要更多这样的东西。

lines.en: : Maybe we can {i}all{/i} get lost in the woods for the next Dorm Wars? Wouldn’t that be fun?
lines.zh: : 要不下一届宿舍战争我们{i}全体{/i}都去森林里迷个路?那不是很好玩吗?

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere15
: No. It most certainly would not be {i}fun.{/i} And you are to never leave my side again. Now be a good girl and remain silent while Futaba reads her story.
lines.zh: : 不。那绝对不{i}好玩{/i}。而且你再也不许离开我身边。现在乖乖的,在 Futaba 读她的故事时保持安静。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere16
: Well, if...nobody else has anything to say...I guess I’ll start reading.
lines.zh: : 那么,如果……没有人还有别的话要说……我想我就开始读了。

lines.en: : Please do. We’re all very excited.
lines.zh: : 请吧。我们都非常期待。

lines.en: : Only if...nobody has anything else to say.
lines.zh: : 前提是……真的没有别人还有话要说。

lines.en: : No one has anything else to say.
lines.zh: : 没有人还有别的话要说。

lines.en: : I’ll just give it a few more minutes before I-
lines.zh: : 那我就再等几分钟,然后我——

lines.en: : Just read the gosh darn story, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 赶紧给我读那个该死的故事,Futaba。

lines.en: : Touka’s getting angry again.
lines.zh: : Touka 又生气了。

lines.en: : Shush you. It’s scary time.
lines.zh: : 你闭嘴。现在是吓人的时间。

lines.en: : This...story is called...uhh...
lines.zh: : 这个……故事叫……呃……

lines.en: : The Ghost of the 63rd Floor...
lines.zh: : 『六十三楼的幽灵』……

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: A long, long time ago...back before cell phones and tablets existed...people needed to actually communicate with one another to pass the time...
lines.zh: : 很久很久以前……在手机和平板电脑还不存在的时候……人们必须真的互相交流,才能打发时间……

lines.en: : But this story begins in a town where that wasn’t possible.
lines.zh: : 可这个故事,开始于一个连那都做不到的镇子。

lines.en: : It was a small, countryside town. So small that you wouldn’t even be able to point it out on a map...but that’s probably for the best considering what happened there.
lines.zh: : 那是个乡下的小镇。小到你甚至没法在地图上指出它的位置……不过考虑到后来那里发生的事,这也许是件好事。

lines.en: : In this town, no one could speak. Which made passing the time impossible. Which made everything there come to a halt.
lines.zh: : 在这个镇上,没有人能说话。这让人无法打发时间。也让那里的一切都停滞了下来。

lines.en: : The schools were quiet. The streets were quiet. And even the seasonal festivals were so quiet that you could walk from one end to the other without hearing a pin drop.
lines.zh: : 学校很安静。街道很安静。就连季节性的庙会也安静到,你从一头走到另一头,连一根针掉在地上的声音都听不到。

lines.en: : But one day, when a girl from the city showed up, that all changed.
lines.zh: : 但有一天,当一个来自城里的女孩出现时,一切都改变了。

lines.en: : This girl wasn’t all that remarkable, but she had something no one else from the village had — a voice.
lines.zh: : 这个女孩并不怎么出众,但她有一件村子里其他任何人都没有的东西——声音。

lines.en: : It was the first time an outsider had even set foot into the city, so the villagers were very cautious. But it wasn’t as if the girl wound up here on purpose, no...
lines.zh: : 这是第一次有外人踏进这座小镇,所以村民们非常警惕。可女孩并不是故意来到这里的,不是的……

lines.en: : She’d simply wandered in on accident and decided to explore.
lines.zh: : 她只是不小心走了进来,然后决定四处看看。

lines.en: : But she slowly became very uneasy in this new environment...
lines.zh: : 可在这个陌生的环境里,她渐渐变得非常不安……

lines.en: : And, incapable of finding her way back to the main road, the girl would move from door to door...hoping someone would be able to guide her home.
lines.zh: : 因为找不到回大路的路,女孩只能挨家挨户地走……希望有人能带她回家。

lines.en: : But one by one, the doors would open and close. And she’d be turned away before even getting the chance to speak.
lines.zh: : 可一扇又一扇门开了又关。她连开口的机会都没有,就被拒之门外。

lines.en: : That is...until she came across a towering apartment complex.
lines.zh: : 直到……她遇见了一栋高耸的公寓楼。

lines.en: : This complex loomed over the village below, casting a shadow on everything else that she’d somehow managed to overlook thus far.
lines.zh: : 这栋楼居高临下地俯视着下面的村庄,在她迄今为止不知怎么忽略掉的一切之上投下阴影。

lines.en: : “There has to be someone there who can help me,” the girl thought, moving ever so closer to a concrete staircase that appeared to expand for miles.
lines.zh: : 「那里一定有人能帮我,」女孩想着,一步步靠近那道看起来延伸了好几英里长的水泥楼梯。

lines.en: : On the first floor, there was no one.
lines.zh: : 一楼,一个人也没有。

lines.en: : On the second floor, she found a cat. But the cat ran off the moment she kneeled down to pet it.
lines.zh: : 二楼,她发现了一只猫。可她一蹲下想摸它,猫就跑掉了。

lines.en: : One by one, she’d scour the perimeter of each floor of the complex, knocking on every single door to no avail.
lines.zh: : 她一层一层地搜遍公寓楼的每一个角落,敲响每一扇门,却毫无结果。

lines.en: : And it wasn’t until the 63rd floor that something changed.
lines.zh: : 直到第六十三层,事情才有了变化。

lines.en: : The girl, who had subconsciously remained silent up until this point, opened her mouth to let out an exasperated sigh.
lines.zh: : 女孩在此之前一直无意识地保持着沉默,这时她张开嘴,想叹出一口烦躁的气。

lines.en: : But when she tried, nothing came out.
lines.zh: : 可她一试,什么声音也没有发出来。

lines.en: : So she tried again. And again. And again. But still, nothing.
lines.zh: : 于是她又试了一次。又一次。再一次。可还是,什么都没有。

lines.en: : Lost and scared, and having no idea who to turn to or where to go to find her way home, the girl dropped to her knees in anguish and tried to cry out to the sky. But again...nothing.
lines.zh: : 迷失又害怕,不知道该求助于谁、该去哪里找回家的路,女孩痛苦地跪倒在地,想对着天空大喊。可再一次……什么都没有。

lines.en: : Until the sound of a door opening behind her {i}tears{/i} her from her pain and loneliness as she {i}shoots{/i} her head back to see who was coming to help her.
lines.zh: : 直到身后传来一扇门打开的声音,把她从痛苦与孤独中猛地{i}拽{/i}了出来,她猛地{i}回过头{/i},想看看是谁来帮她。

lines.en: : To her dismay...it was no one.
lines.zh: : 令她沮丧的是……什么人也没有。

lines.en: : It was just a door.
lines.zh: : 只有一扇门。

lines.en: : “That’s fine,” the girl thought. “There could be someone inside.”
lines.zh: : 「没关系,」女孩想,「里面也许有人。」

lines.en: : Again, she tried to speak these words out loud, but it was all just silent.
lines.zh: : 她又一次试着把这些话说出口,可一切依旧是寂静。

lines.en: : Slowly but surely, she crept over to the door. Her mother and father had always told her to be wary around people she’d never seen before, but she didn’t have much of a choice at this point.
lines.zh: : 她缓慢却坚定地挪到门边。爸爸妈妈一直叮嘱她要提防从没见过的陌生人,可事到如今,她已经没有多少选择了。

lines.en: : Then she {i}grips{/i} the metal frame with tiny, trembling fingers and peers inside!
lines.zh: : 然后她用纤细颤抖的手指{i}抓住{/i}金属门框,往里张望!

lines.en: : But again...
lines.zh: : 可再一次……

lines.en: : There is nothing.
lines.zh: : 什么也没有。

lines.en: : So she takes a step in.
lines.zh: : 于是她迈了进去。

lines.en: : Then another.
lines.zh: : 然后再一步。

lines.en: : And another.
lines.zh: : 再一步。

lines.en: : And she opens her mouth again.
lines.zh: : 然后她再次张开嘴。

lines.en: : But when she tries to speak, her voice comes from somewhere else.
lines.zh: : 可当她想说话时,她的声音却从别的地方传来。

lines.en: : So she follows it...whispering every few seconds to guide her.
lines.zh: : 于是她循着声音走……每隔几秒低语一声,好给自己引路。

lines.en: : And she comes to a room that looks a lot like hers from back home.
lines.zh: : 然后她来到一个房间,看起来和她自己家里的房间很像。

lines.en: : But when she lifts up a picture frame to make sure she isn’t just dreaming, she spots one major difference that helps her realize this isn’t her room at all.
lines.zh: : 可当她拿起一个相框、想确认自己不是在做梦时,她发现了一个重大的不同,让她意识到这里根本不是她的房间。

lines.en: : There was no one in any of these pictures.
lines.zh: : 这些照片里,一个人都没有。

lines.en: : They were taken in the same place and had the same frames...but there was simply no one there.
lines.zh: : 它们是在同一个地方拍的,相框也一样……可就是一个人也没有。

lines.en: : Shocked, the girl lets out a gasp! And when she does, she remembers what led her here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 女孩震惊地倒吸一口气!而就在这一刻,她想起了最初把她带到这里来的东西。

lines.en: : Her own voice {i}leaked{/i} out of a small wardrobe in the corner of the room...one that {i}she{/i} didn’t own — but her mother did.
lines.zh: : 她自己的声音从房间角落的一个小衣柜里{i}漏{/i}了出来……那个衣柜不属于{i}她{/i}——而属于她妈妈。

lines.en: : “Hello?” she whispered. But again, the voice came from the wardrobe instead...
lines.zh: : 「喂?」她低声说。可声音又一次是从衣柜里传出来的,而不是从她嘴里……

lines.en: : Don’t open it! Don’t do it!
lines.zh: : 别打开!千万别!

lines.en: : Shh!
: The girl puts her hand on the handle...
lines.zh: : 女孩把手放在把手上……

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere17
: But when she opens the door, what she sees sends a jolt through her body.
lines.zh: : 可当她打开门,看到的景象让她浑身一震。

lines.en: : She was staring right back at herself...
lines.zh: : 她正与自己四目相对……

lines.en: : Aaaaaahhhhh I knew it!
lines.zh: : 啊——我就知道!

lines.en: : Or at least what used to be her...the girl in the wardrobe must have been dead for years at this point.
lines.zh: : 至少是曾经的自己……衣柜里的那个女孩,此时想必已经死了好多年了。

lines.en: : In a panic, the girl sprinted out of the apartment! She needed to get out of there as soon as possible!
lines.zh: : 女孩惊慌失措地冲出公寓!她必须尽快离开那里!

lines.en: : However...when she made it to the stairs...{i}just{/i} as she was about to climb down them...
lines.zh: : 然而……当她跑到楼梯口……{i}就在{/i}她准备往下走的时候……

lines.en: : She felt a pair of hands on her shoulders.
lines.zh: : 她感到一双手搭在了她的肩膀上。

lines.en: : They pushed her.
lines.zh: : 那双手推了她。

lines.en: : But as she was falling, she was able to spin her body around and see who it was that pushed her.
lines.zh: : 可在坠落的过程中,她扭过身去,看清了推她的是谁。

lines.en: : But what she saw, in her final moments before her neck broke and the life drained from her body, shocked her.
lines.zh: : 可她在脖子折断、生命从身体里流尽之前的最后时刻看到的东西,让她震惊不已。

lines.en: : It was no one at all...
lines.zh: : 根本什么人也不是……

lines.en: : It was the cat.
lines.zh: : 是那只猫。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere18
: Oh, what an interesting ending! Congratulations, Futaba! You have received a passing grade. That was an excellent first attempt.
lines.zh: : 哦,多么有趣的结局!恭喜你,Futaba!你及格了。作为第一次尝试,这非常出色。

lines.en: : Wait, so...who was the girl in the wardrobe thingy? Was the main character dead the whole time?
lines.zh: : 等等,那……衣柜那个东西里的女孩是谁?主角从头到尾都是死的吗?

lines.en: : Heheh...that’s the {i}mystery.{/i} You’re supposed to think about it.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……这就是{i}谜题{/i}所在。本来就该由你自己去想。

lines.en: : She never got to pet the cat...
lines.zh: : 她到最后也没能摸到那只猫……

lines.en: : What a sad ending...
lines.zh: : 真是悲伤的结局……

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere19
: Stories like these rarely have happy endings, Yasu. They’re typically just depressing allegories or parables or things of that nature.
lines.zh: : 这样的故事很少有圆满的结局,Yasu。它们通常只是些令人沮丧的寓言、譬喻,或者类似的东西。

lines.en: : And you like things like that? But you’re so nice.
lines.zh: : 可你喜欢这种东西?可你人那么好。

lines.en: : They’re all just stories, Yasu. None of that ever actually happened.
lines.zh: : 它们都只是故事而已,Yasu。那些事从来没有真的发生过。

lines.en: : But what if it did?
lines.zh: : 可如果真的发生过呢?

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere20
: What if...a girl managed to get lost in a small village where no one could speak and then climbed up 63 flights of stairs to find her body in a wardrobe and be murdered by a cat?
lines.zh: : 万一……有个女孩在一个没人能说话的小村子里迷了路,然后爬了六十三层楼梯,在衣柜里找到了自己的尸体,最后被一只猫杀死了呢?

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : What if that happened?
lines.zh: : 万一真发生了呢?

lines.en: : I...I don’t know, Yasu. I suppose that would be very sad.
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道,Yasu。我想那会非常令人难过。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere21
: Well, Nodoka...the floor is all yours. Don’t be too hard on-
lines.zh: : 那么,Nodoka……接下来交给你了。别对自己太苛——

lines.en: : I don’t want to tell a horror story anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不想再讲恐怖故事了。

lines.en: : Huh? But that’s the whole-
lines.zh: : 哈?可这整个——

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere22
: Wha- Nodoka?!
lines.zh: : 什——Nodoka?!

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere23
: It’s just paper. There will always be more.
lines.zh: : 只是纸而已。纸永远都会有的。

lines.en: : But...those were your-
lines.zh: : 可……那是你的——

lines.en: : Futaba, I doubt she even wrote anything in there. She probably just wanted to make a dramatic entrance or something because she thinks it’ll help her win the horror story contest.
lines.zh: : Futaba,我很怀疑她到底有没有在里面写过什么。她大概只是想来个戏剧性的登场之类的,因为她觉得那样能帮她赢得恐怖故事比赛。

lines.en: : I have no interest in {i}horror.{/i} Nor this competition.
lines.zh: : 我对{i}恐怖{/i}没有兴趣。对这场比赛也没有。

lines.en: : What I want is to tell a love story. So I am going to tell a love story.
lines.zh: : 我想讲的,是一个爱情故事。所以我要讲一个爱情故事。

lines.en: : But that’s not what the competition-
lines.zh: : 可比赛的内容不是——

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere24
: It all begins inside a block of ice. Or a box of dirt. Or a closet of your grandmother’s clothes. Or anywhere you can exist in a way that is only slightly suspicious and not outright burdensome.
lines.zh: : 一切都始于一块冰里。或是一箱泥土里。或是一柜子你祖母的衣服里。又或者,任何你能以「只是略微可疑、而不至于完全是负担」的方式存在的地方。

lines.en: : The protagonist is you. And beside you is a flower. Frozen in time. Finally sprouting. Long deceased and pressed within the arms of a book to prevent rotting.
lines.zh: : 主角是你。而在你身旁有一朵花。被冻结在时间里。终于发芽。早已枯死,被压在书的怀抱里以防腐烂。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere25
: It looked something like this.
lines.zh: : 它大概长这样。

lines.en: : Like what? You’re just standing there.
lines.zh: : 长什么样?你就站在那儿啊。

lines.en: : Your imagination. Use it.
lines.zh: : 用你的想象力。动动脑子。

lines.en: : Picture yourself in a place you are not meant to be during a time in which you are not meant to exist, full of pretty things that were plucked from out of the ground and put somewhere else for safekeeping.
lines.zh: : 想象你身处一个你不该在的地方,存在于一个你不该存在的时间里,周围满是被人从土里拔出、又安置到别处保存起来的漂亮东西。

lines.en: : You were once beautiful — just like your grandmother’s flowers. But now, you’re incapable of staring down at your hands without paying too much attention to the new lines that are forming. Cracking.
lines.zh: : 你曾经很美——就像你祖母的花一样。可现在,你无法低头注视自己的手,而不去过分在意那些新生的纹路。它们在龟裂。

lines.en: : You’re breaking apart and no one can stop it. Not a block of ice. Not a box of dirt. And wearing your grandmother’s clothes could never make you feel young again.
lines.zh: : 你正在分崩离析,没人能阻止。一块冰不行。一箱泥土不行。而穿上你祖母的衣服,也永远不可能让你重新感到年轻。

lines.en: : But that is fine.
lines.zh: : 但那没关系。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere26
: And it’s fine because the you who’s someone else and somewhere else has someone else who will see something else. Else the someone you’ve become won’t be someone at all.
lines.zh: : 之所以没关系,是因为那个身为别人、身处别处的你,会有另一个人去看见另一样东西。否则,你变成的那个「某人」就根本算不上某人。

lines.en: : The ice, the dirt, the closet — they all vanish once the sun rises. But in their absence, you find a special place.
lines.zh: : 冰、泥土、衣柜——太阳一升起,它们全都消失。但在它们消失之处,你找到了一个特别的地方。

lines.en: : You make the mistake of believing you are human and trick yourself into a dangerous state of mind by reverting to where it is you would have come from should you have actually been born.
lines.zh: : 你犯了一个错误,以为自己是人类,于是倒退回「如果你真的出生过,本该来自的地方」,把自己骗进一种危险的心境。

lines.en: : In between the legs of a woman you’d learn to call “mother,” as that is the word that best describes the relationship you have...you’d find a meaning in existing that is greater than simply surviving.
lines.zh: : 在一个你会学着称之为「母亲」的女人的双腿之间——因为这个词最能描述你们之间的关系……你会找到一种比单纯活下去更伟大的存在意义。

lines.en: : You would find penitence. Cowardice. And experience the warmth of detached arms, stretching out their skin and covering you like a blanket as you proceed to grow as the rest of the world shrinks.
lines.zh: : 你会找到忏悔。怯懦。还会体会到那双超然的手臂的温暖——它们撑开自己的皮肤,像毯子一样盖住你,而你在成长,世界的其余部分却在萎缩。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere27
: But your dependence on this brand new entity becomes more than a simple longing to be enveloped by Mother’s infinitely expanding arms or the scent between her legs.
lines.zh: : 但你对这个全新存在的依赖,渐渐超越了单纯想要被母亲无限扩张的手臂、或是她双腿之间的气味包裹的渴望。

lines.en: : What she is and what she stands for eats away at your preexisting view of the world — reshapes the ideas you formed when you were hardly more than a cautious springtail.
lines.zh: : 她是谁、她代表什么,侵蚀着你先前对世界的看法——重塑了你在还不过是一只谨慎的跳虫时形成的那些观念。

lines.en: : But where does love come into play? At what point does this become more than the maniacal rambling of a girl you all simply fail to understand because her mind doesn’t work the same way yours does?
lines.zh: : 可爱又在哪里登场呢?从哪一刻起,这不再只是一个你们都理解不了的女孩的疯言疯语——只因为她的脑子和你们的不一样?

lines.en: : It comes into play in the very beginning. Before all of this. And a child raised by wolves would act more like a dog than a human, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 它在最开始就登场了。在这一切之前。而被狼养大的孩子,举止会更像狗而不是人,你们不觉得吗?

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere28
: The glow of all three moons reforms into one infinite stream of light! Covering the land and helping plants grow while killing off those who learned to walk without its assistance!
lines.zh: : 三轮月亮的光辉重新汇聚成一道无限的光流!它覆盖大地,让植物生长,同时杀死那些学会了不借助它也能行走的家伙!

lines.en: : The ice melts! The dirt dries up! And a leak through the bottom of your grandmother’s closet allows in a virus that makes its way up the walls to nest in her blouses unworn!
lines.zh: : 冰融化了!泥土干涸了!而你祖母衣柜底部的裂缝放进来一种病毒,它沿着墙壁爬上去,在她那些没穿过的女衫里筑巢!

lines.en: : {i}But no! This is love!{/i} You think that from the bottom of a heart that you are just finding out is real. And you recall your mother’s scent one more time as your body starts to burn up!
lines.zh: : {i}可不对!这就是爱!{/i}你从一颗刚发现自己是真的的心底如此想着。而当你的身体开始燃烧时,你又一次回忆起母亲的气味!

lines.en: : You recall why you think the things you do and how all of the thoughts you had without her were nothing more than misguided delusions or the nightmares you’d eat to fill your belly!
lines.zh: : 你想起自己为什么会这样想,也想起没有她时你所有的念头,不过是被误导的妄想,或是你为了填饱肚子而吞下的噩梦!

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere29
: But what is a thought if it’s not a thought you think to yourself? And what good is {i}guidance{/i} if you’ll be forced to fend for yourself in the years the grass stops growing?!
lines.zh: : 可如果一个念头不是你自己对自己想的念头,那它还算什么念头?而如果在青草停止生长的年月里你终将被迫自谋生路,{i}指引{/i}又有什么用?!

lines.en: : These questions eat away at you! So you seek comfort in the arms that open up, but not {i}too{/i} much as larger wingspans scare you! You’ve been preyed upon by them before!
lines.zh: : 这些问题一点点吞噬着你!于是你向张开的双臂寻求安慰,但又不敢{i}太{/i}过,因为更大的翼展会让你害怕!你曾经被它们捕食过!

lines.en: : Like a vulture in reverse, you place decaying meat back onto the bones of what has already been killed by the infinite light, and hope that time will reverse its course and bring them back to life!
lines.zh: : 像一只反向的秃鹫,你把腐肉重新放回那些已被无限之光杀死的骸骨上,希望时间能倒流,让它们复活!

lines.en: : But what has already been cut down is not the same as {i}you!{/i} You can be picked clean as many times as it takes and {i}still{/i} persist as {i}you{/i} are the main character! You’ve known that from the start.
lines.zh: : 可那些已经被砍倒的东西,和{i}你{/i}并不一样!你可以被啃干净多少次都行,却{i}依然{/i}存在,因为{i}你{/i}就是主角!这一点你从一开始就知道。

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere30
: And what you love is how, at often times, it may feel as if everyone else is simply acting out a play.
lines.zh: : 而你所爱的,是那种时常会有的感觉——似乎其他所有人都只是在演一出戏。

lines.en: : What you love is the person who taught you that life is more than just a block of ice or a box of dirt or the clothes in your grandmother’s closet.
lines.zh: : 你所爱的,是那个教会你「人生不只是一块冰、一箱泥土、或祖母衣柜里的衣服」的人。

lines.en: : What you love is the one who thawed you out. Who propagated you. Who dressed you in clothes you could wear with pride.
lines.zh: : 你所爱的,是那个把你解冻的人。那个让你繁衍的人。那个给你穿上可以骄傲地穿着的衣服的人。

lines.en: : And while your feelings are true and your feelings are {i}real,{/i} the script says that you are meant to stay frozen...That you’re an ever-blooming tree...And that the bedroom is for other boys.
lines.zh: : 尽管你的感情是真挚的、是{i}真实{/i}的,剧本却说你注定要保持冰冻……说你是一棵永远开花的树……还说卧室是属于别的男孩的。

lines.en: scene black
: But wait...
lines.zh: : 可是等等……

lines.en: : There was something else beside you, wasn’t there?
lines.zh: : 你身边还有别的东西,不是吗?

lines.en: : A flower...Frozen in time. Finally sprouting- yet long deceased and pressed within the arms of a book to prevent rotting.
lines.zh: : 一朵花……被冻结在时间里。终于发芽——却早已枯死,被压在书的怀抱里以防腐烂。

lines.en: : What became of {i}that?{/i} Or {i}it?{/i} Or {i}her?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那东西{/i}后来怎么样了?或者说,{i}它{/i}?或者说,{i}她{/i}?

lines.en: : Now, back in the place you once were, where your story both begins and ends...you remember that you were only alone because you forgot to glance over.
lines.zh: : 现在,回到你曾经所在的那个地方,你的故事在那里开始,也在那里结束……你想起来,你之所以孤独,只是因为你忘了往旁边看一眼。

lines.en: : And that the stasis in which you exist, as peculiar and inexplicable as it may be, is your {i}true{/i} home.
lines.zh: : 而你所处的这种停滞,无论多么奇特、多么难以解释,就是你{i}真正{/i}的家。

lines.en: : It is here where larger wingspans do not terrify you, for {i}you{/i} are the apex predator. And {i}you{/i} can pick the meat off of any carcass you like.
lines.zh: : 正是在这里,更大的翼展不会让你恐惧,因为{i}你{/i}才是顶级掠食者。{i}你{/i}可以从任何一具尸体上啄下你想要的肉。

lines.en: : The three moons smile down at you. They pat you on the head and call you a good boy. And it is those divine hands that remind you of {i}her{/i} one last time.
lines.zh: : 三轮月亮对你微笑。它们拍拍你的头,说你是个好孩子。而正是那双神圣的手,让你最后一次想起{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : But did she ever exist in the first place?
lines.zh: : 可她从一开始到底存在过吗?

lines.en: : Or do you just {i}think{/i} she did?
lines.zh: : 还是说,你只是{i}以为{/i}她存在过?

lines.en: scene uhhhhhhhscenegoeshere31
: If that is not love, I don’t know what love is. But I’d ask that you do not hold it against me if my definition of the word differs from yours for I have yet to fully thaw.
lines.zh: : 如果那不是爱,那我不知道什么是爱。不过,如果我对这个词的定义与你们不同,还请不要因此责怪我,因为我还没有完全解冻。

lines.en: : And I still long for someone to steal me away from my {i}own{/i} block or box or closet and provide me a purpose as I can not figure one out on my own.
lines.zh: : 而我依然渴望有人把我从{i}自己{/i}的冰块、箱子或衣柜里偷走,给我一个存在的目的,因为我自己想不出来。

lines.en: I don’t know how I got here.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己是怎么来到这里的。

lines.en: : There is nothing more dangerous than being trapped in an empty space with little more than the voices in your head, as {i}they’re{/i} the ones pulling the levers and gears inside of you.
lines.zh: : 没有什么比被关在一个空荡荡的地方、身边只剩下你脑海里的声音更危险的了,因为正是{i}它们{/i}在拉动你体内的操纵杆和齿轮。

lines.en: I don’t know what I’m listening to.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己在听什么。

lines.en: : But a question no one ever asks is if it's possible to fall in love with {i}them.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但有个从来没人问过的问题是,有没有可能爱上{i}它们{/i}。

lines.en: : Is it possible to come to {i}enjoy{/i} the company you create rather than the company you find?
lines.zh: : 有没有可能,渐渐{i}喜欢{/i}上自己创造出来的陪伴,而不是自己遇见的陪伴?

lines.en: But I feel compelled to grab her.
lines.zh: 可我忍不住想抓住她。

lines.en: : If you can believe it, I think so.
lines.zh: : 如果你能相信,那我觉得可以。

lines.en: : If you can {i}feel{/i} them, I think so.
lines.zh: : 如果你能{i}感觉{/i}到它们,那我觉得可以。

lines.en: To cut her into pieces.
lines.zh: 把她切成碎片。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I can’t help but wonder if {i}I’m{/i} a voice in someone’s head.
lines.zh: : 有时候,我忍不住想,{i}我{/i}会不会只是某个人脑海里的一个声音。

lines.en: : If there’s someone who takes shelter not in my body, but in the idea of my existence.
lines.zh: : 会不会有某个人,栖身的不是我的身体,而是「我存在」这个念头。

lines.en: And replant them somewhere else.
lines.zh: 然后把它们重新种到别的地方。

lines.en: : And as lonely as that may sound...I {i}like{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 尽管听起来很孤独……可我{i}喜欢{/i}。

lines.en: : For it makes my being far more free.
lines.zh: : 因为这让我的存在自由得多。

lines.en: : And it gives me more time to {i}think.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而且给了我更多{i}思考{/i}的时间。

lines.en: : Nodoka. Can you come with me for a minute?
lines.zh: : Nodoka。你能跟我来一下吗?

lines.en: : This concludes my love story.
lines.zh: : 我的爱情故事到此结束。

lines.en: : {i}Daddy calls.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}爸爸在叫我。{/i}
